from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from .models import CorporateTierFXSpread
from .serializers import CorporateTierFXSpreadSerializer

class CorporateTierFXSpreadUpdateView(generics.RetrieveUpdateAPIView):
    # Restrict modification of FX fee spreads strictly to billing administrators
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAdminUser]
    serializer_class = CorporateTierFXSpreadSerializer
    queryset = CorporateTierFXSpread.objects.all()
    lookup_field = "tier_code"

    def get_object(self):
        code = self.kwargs.get("tier_code")
        return generics.get_object_or_404(self.queryset, tier_code=code)
